controles.affirmation: Faiblesse significative sur les impots differes identifiee fin 2025, non corrigee au 30 juin 2026 ; DG et DAF par interim concluent que les controles n'etaient pas efficaces
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 Item 4 : "a material weakness was identified in internal control over financial reporting related to the accounting for deferred income taxes (...) The material weakness in internal control over financial reporting was not remediated as of June 30, 2026" ; "our Chief Executive Officer and Interim Chief Financial Officer concluded that, as of June 30, 2026, our disclosure controls and procedures were not effective" ; "management believes and has concluded that the condensed consolidated financial statements (...) fairly present, in all material respects".

controles.affirmation: Recours collectif Waterford Twp. depose le 4 fevrier 2025 (Sections 10(b) et 20(a)) ; deux poursuites derivees dont Moore v. Hsing du 16 juin 2026 ; societe qualifie la plainte de sans fondement
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "On February 4, 2025, a class action lawsuit was filed (...) Waterford Twp. Gen. Emps. Ret. Sys. v. Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. (...) alleges that we violated Sections 10(b) and 20(a) (...) We believe the lawsuit is meritless (...) One shareholder derivative suit has been filed under the caption Moore v. Hsing, et al. (...) filed on June 16, 2026, and the two other shareholder derivative suits have been consolidated under the caption Miller v. Hsing, et al."
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance a ajouter : il y a trois actions derivees regroupees sous deux intitules, et "The Derivative Litigation is stayed pending developments in the Securities Action" ; la societe indique aussi ne pas juger probable une perte significative.

controles.affirmation: 88% des ventes totales passent par des distributeurs et revendeurs tiers
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "For each of the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, 88 % of the Company's total sales were made through distribution arrangements."
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance disponible et plus parlante : 83% un an plus tot, donc la desintermediation s'accentue.

controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Gross margin 55.2% (2025) | 55.3% (2024) | 56.1% (2023)" ; 10-K FY2022 : "Gross margin was 58.4% for the year ended December 31, 2022" ; 10-Q T2 2026 : "Gross margin was 55.2% for the three months ended June 30, 2026" et 55,3% sur six mois.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : sur un an la marge brute progresse legerement (55,1% au T2 2025 -> 55,2% au T2 2026), le recul est un mouvement pluriannuel.

controles.correction_proposee: Ajouter que l'exercice 2024 est presente 'As Restated' dans le 10-K FY2025, ce qui renforce l'argument.

controles.affirmation: Distributeur A 28%, B 15%, C 11%, D 10% au T2 2026, soit 64% cumules, en hausse contre environ 42% a 53% un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, tableau des clients >=10% du CA, colonnes T2 2026 puis T2 2025 : "Distributor A 28 % | 25 % ; Distributor B 15 % | 17 % ; Distributor C * | 11 % ; Distributor D 10 % | * " avec "* Represents less than 10%". Le 11% de Distributeur C est la colonne T2 2025, pas T2 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Au T2 2026 les distributeurs declares >=10% sont A 28%, B 15% et D 10%, soit 53% publies (C repasse sous 10%). Au T2 2025 : A 25%, B 17%, C 11%, soit 53% egalement. La concentration publiee est stable, elle n'augmente pas : retirer le '64% cumules' et la these de concentration croissante, ou la reformuler sur le seul distributeur A (25% -> 28%).
